title: filenode-server README still documents -14 nodeType inference
description: crate-jmap-filenode-server/README.md:145-152 says FileNode/set create infers nodeType from blobId/target when absent. After this change, src/filenode.rs:303-311 rejects a create with no @type (invalidProperties ['@type'], per draft-16 §3.1.1). The README also cites draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-14 (lines 5, 47, 253, 256), as do module and fn docs in src/filenode.rs (lines 1, 18, 49, 53, 122, 160, ...). PLAN.md:257-341 has the same stale inference text. Implementers reading the README will omit @type and get errors. Update the README section and the rustdoc spec citations to -16.
close_reason: fixed in working tree (uncommitted), verified by adversarial reviewer + cargo test
